name: Synthetic divider resistance fit
source:
// Synthetic fitting tutorial: recover the series resistance from two stimulus conditions.
// This is workflow evidence, not a physical measurement or model-identification claim.
param resistance: Ohm = 1k
param drive: V = 1V
net GND
net IN
net OUT
source VIN sine(0V,{drive},100Hz)
resistor RS {resistance}
resistor RL 1k
connect VIN.minus, RL.p2 to GND
connect VIN.plus, RS.p1 to IN
connect RS.p2, RL.p1 to OUT
simulate tran 50us 20ms
